tasks.label: C/C++: cl.exe 生成活动文件
args: call E:\VS\VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvarsall.bat x64 -vcvars_ver=14.51.36231 && cl.exe /EHsc /Zi /Fe:${fileDirname}\${fileBasenameNoExtension}.exe ${file} /link /INCREMENTAL:NO && if exist ${fileDirname}\*.obj del /Q ${fileDirname}\*.obj ${fileDirname}\vc140.pdb
tasks.detail: MSVC cl.exe (自动清理 .obj 和 vc140.pdb)
